welcome.title: Mobile Babysitter
welcome.subtitle: A premium baby monitor that runs entirely on your phones — private by design.

p2p.title: Local peer-to-peer
p2p.body: Your two phones talk directly over your home WiFi — works even without internet.

noCloud.title: No cloud, no accounts
noCloud.body: Audio and video never touch a server. There is nothing to hack and nothing to leak.

e2e.title: End-to-end encrypted
e2e.body: Every stream is encrypted between your devices, so only you can ever see or hear it.

permissions.title: A few permissions
permissions.subtitle: We only ask for what the monitor needs. You can change any of these later, and you can continue even if you skip them now.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: Streams live video of your baby to the parent phone — peer-to-peer and encrypted, never uploaded.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.body: Lets you hear your baby and powers on-device cry detection. Audio stays between your devices.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Alerts you about crying or movement even when the app is in the background.

reRequest.title: Permissions needed
reRequest.subtitle: The monitor needs the permissions below to work. Granting takes a moment and nothing leaves your devices.
reRequest.blockedGuidance: This was turned off and can only be re-enabled in your device Settings.

roleSelect.title: What is this phone for?
roleSelect.subtitle: You can change this any time before pairing.

baby.title: Baby unit
baby.body: Leave this phone with your baby. It streams audio and video to the parent phone.

parent.title: Parent unit
parent.body: Keep this phone with you. It watches and listens, and alerts you about crying or movement.

about.tagline: Privacy-first baby monitor. Peer-to-peer, no cloud, no account.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Mobile Babysitter is privacy-first by design. The points below summarise how the app works.

points.p2p: Peer-to-peer: video and audio stream directly between your two phones.
points.noCloud: No cloud: your stream is never uploaded to or stored on our servers.
points.noAccount: No account: there is no sign-up, no login, and no email required.

privacyPolicy.footnote: This text is a placeholder and does not constitute the final, legally binding privacy policy.

network.offline: No network connection — the monitor can't reach the other phone.
